newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money traded at 12.0/13.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money traded at 12.0/13.0 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was traded at 12.0/13.0 percent on Wednesday on the back of adequate rupiah supply, dealers said.
Dealers said an early central bank injection of some 180 billion rupiah helped eased the rates, which hovered at around 13.0/14.0 percent on Tuesday.
One state-owned bank dealer said overnight money tended to ease, with many offers seen from state banks.
Another local bank dealer said one-week money was last at 13.50/13.75 percent and two-week money at 13.75/14.00 percent. One-month money was at 14.0/14.25.
The average overnight interbank rate on Tuesday was 13.44 percent compared with 12.33 percent on Monday.
